Subject: Stage & close-date sweep: SFDC hygiene actions (EOD Wed)

Team —

Quick hygiene push ahead of week close and the Friday forecast lock: please do a focused sweep of the SFDC opportunities you own and complete these three items by EOD Wednesday (11/11):

1) Commit vs. Pull: Mark deals as COMMIT only if you have a clear, signed verbal commitment or written buying signal and a confirmed date. If not, move to "Best Case" or "On Hold" and add a one-line reason.

2) Close Date Accuracy: If a deal is not realistically closing in the current month, update the Close Date (do not leave tentative dates). For any deals you move out of the quarter, add the expected month in the Opportunity Notes.

3) Stale Opps: If no activity in 30+ days and no near-term exec/POC engagement, move to "Disqualified" or "On Hold" and set a reason so Finance knows why it fell out of commit.

I exported a snapshot of the current Q4 view and attached it (q4_pipeline_snapshot_20261108.csv). Use the SFDC list view: "Forecast Sweep - Q4" (Close Date between 2026-11-01 and 2026-12-31, Stage not Closed). If you need help filtering, ping me.

Why this matters: Finance will run the commit snapshot at 10:00am PT Friday and we want the Commit column to reflect only verified deals — that'll prevent artificial churn in the official forecast.

If you have edge cases (large logo, pending procurement, multi-PO), reply with specific deal IDs and I’ll adjudicate. I’ll host a short commit review at 9:00am PT Thursday for any disputes.

Thanks — appreciate quick turn on this.

—
